title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-jul-2026-maya-personal-notes
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML)
Date: 2026-07-16 10:00am PT (weekly slot)
Attendees (planned): Priya, Raj, Dylan, Asha, John (SRE), me (Maya) + optional: Lina (Console)
Goal: Quick sync to make sure Product priorities and Eng capacity align for H2 initiatives; surface gating research work; lock canary timelines and owners for model rollouts.

Prep notes / things to surface:
- Product asks: finalize prioritization across 3 initiatives: 1) Dedicated autoscaling policies (high impact on committed revenue), 2) KV-cache optimization for long-tail token workflows (cost savings), 3) Structured output + function-calling polish (customer-facing UX).
- Eng capacity: sprint velocity looks ~10% lower next 2 sprints due to release-ops and infra upgrade. Raj already flagged node-level rebalancer work stealing ~2 FTE-equivalents for 3 weeks.
- Research (Applied ML): have a prototype quantization profile for xformers-128 that reduces mem by ~30% but needs validation on long-context chats; ML wants 2 weeks to run stability evals on top 1k customer prompts. This is a gating dependency for rolling quantized model to Dedicated.
- Risks: if ML validation slips, cost-savings initiative (KV-cache+quant) might not land before big sales demos in Sep. Prioritization trade-off: short-term sales enablement vs long-term unit-economics.

Agenda (6 items, 35 minutes):
1) Quick round (5m): confirm attendees & any blockers
2) Review top priorities & customer asks (10m): Priya presents one-pager, highlight deadlines (Aug 30 demo)
3) Capacity & timeline constraints (8m): Raj to explain infra/ops constraints + proposed mitigation (temp contractor, shift sprint scope)
4) Research gating (5m): Asha on validation plan and risks if failure modes show up
5) Trade-offs & decision (5m): Decide if we: A) defer KV-cache full rollout to Sep, B) scope a minimal patch for demos, or C) change demo expectations
6) Action items & owners (2m)

Notes to self (things to ask / confirm during sync):
- Ask Product: which customer demos are hard commitments vs nice-to-have? Who is owning demo success? (Sales/CS contact)
- Ask Eng: can we carve out a fast path: minimal KV-cache improvements that only touch hot-prefixes (low-risk)? Estimate: 1 sprint + 1 engineer + ops runbook?
- Ask Research: what are top 3 failure modes you expect with quant profile? If one shows up, what's the rollback plan? Is there a canary gating metric (latency, perplexity delta, hallucination rate)?
- Dependencies: SRE must sign off on canary rollout policy; Console team needs UI flags for model variant selection (Lina).

Quick draft decisions I want to push for:
- Prioritize Dedicated autoscaling + demo-critical structured-output fixes for August demo window. Defer full KV-cache rollout until ML stability validated, but ship a minimal hot-prefix patch for demos.
- Allocate 0.5 sprint worth of contractor/rotating on-call to unblock node rebalancer; Raj to propose specific resource plan by EOD 7/17.
- Research: Asha to run 1k prompt eval + targeted failure-case tests by 7/30; if pass -> greenlight quantized variant for canary in Dedicated. If fail -> freeze quant rollout and schedule post-demo follow-ups.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Sales demo on Aug 30: is the dataset they’ll use parity with our eval set? Need contact (CS lead) to get sample prompts.
- Cost math: need updated per-token numbers with proposed hot-prefix cache patch vs full KV-cache rollout (ask Finance to re-run quick sim).
- Is there an easy UX fallback for customers if structured output regresses? Maybe model knob in Console to select previous model variant.

Action items (I'll capture and follow-up):
action_items: Raj: propose resource mitigation plan for node rebalancer by EOD 2026-07-17
Asha: run 1k prompt stability eval + targeted failure tests and share results by 2026-07-30
Priya/Product: confirm demo commitment list + CS contact by 2026-07-18
Lina/Console: scope minimal UI flag for model variant selection and estimate effort (target: 1 sprint) by 2026-07-20
Maya (me): prepare minimal hot-prefix KV-cache proposal + quick cost sim for meeting (have baseline numbers ready)
Dylan: list top customer-impacting regression metrics for canary gating (latency, perplexity delta, hallucination proxy) by next sync
decisions: Tentative: defer full KV-cache rollout until ML validation completes; ship minimal hot-prefix patch for demos if feasible
Tentative: prioritize Dedicated autoscaling and structured output fixes for Aug demo window
meeting_minutes_followup_plan: I'll take notes in the meeting and post an async summary to the roadmap Confluence page. After the meeting, ping owners on slack (#roadmap-sync) and update JIRA tickets: ENG-2124 (autoscale), INFRA-309 (node rebalancer), ML-487 (quant validation).
personal_todos: Bring up demo dataset parity question during meeting
Have quick backup wording for product if we need to push demo expectations (2 options: limited scope vs postpone demo)
